title: Differential Phase Contrast using Precession Illumination at pn Junction in GaAs
content: Visualization techniques of static potentials at pn junctions in devices and their analytical methods are in increasing demand for semi-conductor industries. These techniques enable detailed observation of the structural and electrical properties of the junction and provide an accurate means of identifying defects and non-uniformities within the device. They also enable a better understanding of the pn junction formation process and improved process conditions. Thus, these techniques and methods play an essential role in improving the quality, operating characteristics, and ultimately the overall performance of semiconductor devices.
